direction.name: 복구된 경계의 편집
direction.organization: Two unequal large close-up crops of repaired wood and sewn textile meet in an interlocking edge spanning the poster, with a smaller context cutout of actual shared work. The real copy occupies one broad upright opening shaped by that joint, not left hero/right stacked copy.
direction.concept: The repaired joint and stitched fabric show value in keeping everyday things; one concrete shared gesture ties these material details to community repair.
direction.image_grammar: High-detail photographic material crops edited with hard confident boundaries and limited ultramarine/acid-yellow flat accents at real intersections. Warm worn wood, contrasting seam and tactile garment, no fake embossed typography or arbitrary chromed object.
direction.body_flow: Title interacts with the interlocking edge at moderate scale. Full description follows immediately along the same opening; event/date/time/place and fee/deadline/item/URL have stable optically aligned starts in adjacent functional groups. Broad body area and robust upright letters established at720 display before enlarging the crops. No tiny isolated captions or corner URL.
direction.type: Carefully typeset contemporary Korean sans body with slightly wide mature forms, stable medium-weight strokes, balanced Latin/numerals; title a tighter contrasting typographic voice.
direction.distinctness: Interlocking unequal enlarged material boundaries and contextual cutout; not a top-down tool network, ordered photo strip, continuous depicted room/table or illustrated episode structure.

common_constraints: Resolve the actual whole structure and readable body area first; material names are subordinate to that design.
Use the already-collected design idea library; no fresh browsing, no source re-opening or source paperwork. No source raster is a client asset.
Each native prompt prints the full required copy once, chosen positive visual relationships and relevant conditions; no rubric or JSON dump.

720px-wide social/community display is a coordinator design assumption, not a new client-fixed pixel/font/layout requirement. Mature body typically14–18px at that display implies ample paragraph area, not tiny footer print.
Coordinator relationships are design guidance; actual successful distinct relationships may vary without repairs to match coordinates.
Do not inspect peers or external critic feedback; preserve every initial and bounded repair and close own selection first.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
